content: godbus custom-bus usage (evidence: sarim/goibus): dbus.Dial(address) connects to arbitrary D-Bus sockets like the IBus private socket; conn.Auth(nil/External) + conn.Hello() complete handshake; conn.Export(receiver any, path, iface) registers method handlers (methods with (T,...) (R, *dbus.Error) signatures); conn.Emit(path, iface.Member, args...) sends signals; conn.Object(dest, path).Call(iface.method, flags, args...) for synchronous calls; conn.RequestName for name ownership. Works for implementing both IBus engine (ibus socket) and control service (session bus) in one Go process.
